Everything is complete. Here's a summary:

**What happened:** checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.

**What I did:**
1. Checked deployment history — confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), so I retried and successfully rolled out us-west and eu-west as well.
3. Verified post-rollback: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0, the service is **healthy**, and the error rate dropped from 18% to **0.2%**.
4. Opened a **SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failure and rollback. The initial creation call timed out, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was created successfully and is open — no duplicate was made.

**Follow-up recommendation:** investigate the v2.3.1 release (e.g., check its changes and staging behavior) before attempting to redeploy it.
